intent: Change one thing: widen the sensor row from ±0.02 m at 12 mm to ±0.03 m at 16 mm, in 0.015 m steps, at y = 0.04. The aim is more warning before the 0.06 m off-track limit, since line loss persists after progress 0.1 on the s-bend and oval. I kept the forward offset, wheel, body and mass unchanged, and I am not moving the row forward because slalom oscillation (0.145) is below the 0.15 trigger. Expected result: fewer line-loss events and max error held below 0.06 for longer, with slalom oscillation near or below 0.145. If the row is wider and the controller gain is still too high for the new spacing, the Integrator should lower kp rather than narrow the row. I am considering a forward offset of y = 0.02 later, but only if oscillation rises to 0.15 or more on the slalom.
learning: Hypotheses for the next race: (1) with the wider row, line loss moves later in each run or disappears on the bends, which would confirm that coverage at the row edge was the limit; (2) if line loss still starts near progress 0, coverage is not the cause and the controller or start-up is; (3) the 16 mm footprint may read more noise at the row edges, so a rise in steering_oscillation would point to footprint size rather than reach. Please report, in the integration feedback, the progress at the first line-loss event on each track and the max error at that moment. That separates coverage-edge loss from controller overshoot, although it is not one of the allowed measurement names.
rationale: Evidence from iteration 2 (60 trials, all off track, no finishes): progress 0.11 to 0.19, one to two line-loss events per run, max error about 0.06 m. That is the off-track limit for body_width 0.12, max(0.06, 0.0125 + 0.12/4) = 0.06, and body width cannot relax it within the allowed range. The robot therefore loses the line before it stalls, and coverage at the row edge is the open question. Iteration 2 raised the score from 57.1 to 63.9 and cut slalom oscillation from 0.150 to 0.145, so the controller change helped. The Integrator's advice was to hold geometry for this race, which I did. Their rule for the next change was: if line loss persists after progress 0.1, widen the row to x = ±0.03 with 16 mm sensors. Line loss on the s-bend (2 events, progress 0.19) and oval (1 event, progress 0.18) comes after progress 0.1 at the end of the run, so I am taking that step. Their second trigger, a forward offset when slalom oscillation is at or above 0.15, is not met (0.145), so I am not moving the row forward. Coverage check: a 16 mm footprint at x = ±0.03 keeps tape under the outer sensor until the robot centre is offset by about 0.0125 + 0.008 + 0.03 = 0.0505 m, against about 0.0385 m for the current row. That gives roughly 1.2 cm more warning before the 0.06 m limit. I am keeping the 5-sensor count, y = 0.04, wheel, body and mass unchanged, so the Integrator's controller is judged on one geometry change only. Expected result: fewer line-loss events past progress 0.1, and max error that stays under 0.06 for longer. A finish is still not expected this iteration.
